sentences.en: These people live in unsanitary conditions.
sentences.zh: 这些人生活在不卫生的环境中。

sentences.en: The bathroom is really unsanitary with visible dirt on the toilet.
sentences.zh: 浴室真的很不卫生，马桶上能看到脏东西。

sentences.en: They complained about the unsanitary food at the street vendor’s stand.
sentences.zh: 他们抱怨街边摊的食物很不卫生。
